audience: boards and managers of homeowners associations that run their community in HOA.to

useCases.title: Check the open balance of a unit
useCases.text: List the open charges, then read a unit ledger for its running balance and outstanding total.

useCases.title: Track maintenance and ARC requests
useCases.text: List the requests, filtered by kind, status, unit or open state. Read one request in full to see its details.

useCases.title: Record a check or bank payment
useCases.text: Record a payment that you collected outside HOA.to, such as by check. It applies to the unit's open charges, oldest first, and moves no money.

useCases.title: File a violation with photos
useCases.text: Record a violation against a unit, with photo URLs. It sends no notice and sets no fine. A person decides the next step in HOA.to.

useCases.title: Publish a document to owners
useCases.text: Publish a document that is already hosted at a URL, and set who can see it. Owners with that access can see it at once.

useCases.title: Review upcoming meetings and their agendas
useCases.text: List the upcoming board and committee meetings, then read one meeting with its agenda and minutes.
